data.name: Jenna
data.gender_notes: Jenna is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Jenna derives from Jennah, meaning 'graceful' or 'dear'. In Greek, it can be derived from the name Ianna, meaning 'goddess of the house'. In Latin, it can be derived from Ienna, meaning 'white wave'. In Christian tradition, Jenna represents purity, gentleness, and nurturing. The name Jenna carries the meaning “Graceful, dear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jenna usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, dear and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: ג'נה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ג'נה הוא שם שמשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא חנון לי' או 'חנני אלוהים'. השם ג'נה נגזר מהשפה העברית וקשור למושג החסד והרחמים האלוהיים. הוא משמש לעיתים קרובות כביטוי לאהבה ולקבלה מצד האל.

in_greek.name: Τζένα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Τζένα προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'Χάρις από τον Θεό' ή 'Δωρεά του Θεού'. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Τζένα συνδέεται με την έννοια της χάριτος και της αγάπης του Θεού προς την ανθρωπότητα.

in_latin.name: Jenna
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Jenna significat 'Deus miseri cordis est' vel 'Gratia Dei'. In traditione christiana, nomen Jenna refertur ad conceptum misericordiae et gratiae divinae, quod Deus habet cor misericors et donat gratiam suam hominibus.

in_english.meaning: God is gracious or God has shown favor

It reflects the spiritual significance of God's favor and kindness towards humanity.
